scope: All completed unique heldout C0 runs. A Native run reused across cuts is counted once. Client ITL equals worker-emission gap plus delivery-delay change. No timestamp is corrected. A client violation with worker gap<=34ms locates the violation in delivery-delay growth. This identity does not identify a blocked syscall,GC,CPU scheduling or GPU operator cause. Counts across runs are descriptive,not a server-start confidence interval. C0 is not C3 continuous serving.
